# The Lobby
The lobby is the theater where every player who joins the server appears. The theater is a physical space for you to immerse yourself in while waiting for a new round.
Everything you need to do to join a round is located here, as long as a few other interesting things to interact with.
# The Stage
The stage is where you go to join a round. If the round currently isn't ongoing, you can [bold]stand on the stage to ready up[/bold] for the next round.
You can access your job preferences menu via an action you gain when on the stage.
# Latejoining
Once a round starts, anyone who wishes to join will have to speak to the Casting Director or the Stagehand Director.
Speaking to the Casting Director allows you to join the round as a player, though, anyone who latejoins will not be given a unique mask.
Speaking to the Stagehand Director allows you to join the round as a stagehand, which is an observer who can vote on events throughout the round, and affect the players in a few minor ways to make the round more interesting.
